Covered: every GIT_TRACE* sibling by prefix (absolute or ~ writes, a descriptor/off/relative value is silent, a value the hook cannot read refuses a member), GIT_INDEX_FILE and GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY, --output on any verb, archive/format-patch -o and --output-directory, bundle create, bugreport, diagnose, checkout-index --prefix, mailsplit, mailinfo, pack-objects, index-pack, read-tree --index-output, fast-export --export-marks, commit-graph and multi-pack-index --object-dir, repack --expire-to/--filter-to, credential-store --file, in every spelling git takes. git init and git clone carry no entry: GIT_WRITE_VERBS refuses both to a member whole.

SPD-045: directories.redirect_descriptor (directories.py:17-28), used by separate_redirects -- a digit or - operand is a descriptor only after >&.
SPD-037: directory_change adds os.access(d, os.X_OK) beside os.path.isdir (directories.py:246-254).
SPD-035: bash_rule.targets_reason returns the unfollowable reason for every caller, not members alone (bash_rule.py:246, 265).
Objective 5: FINDING_LAST gains path and hashed at 1 (spud_calls.py:178-184).

Tests, tests/test_hooks.py: GitFileWriteTest (4837, 20 methods), DescriptorRedirectTest (5095, 6), UnenterableDirTest (5157, 4), PathInForceTest.test_a_later_command_that_earns_its_own_refusal_answers_before_the_path_reason (4540), and four flipped: ShellModelTest.test_directories_the_hook_cannot_follow, GlobRedirectTest.test_a_glob_over_a_directory_the_hook_cannot_follow, TrapActionTest.test_the_action_runs_where_the_hook_cannot_know_the_directory and its coproc case (Spud now refused), plus ZshGlobOperatorTest.test_controls_stay_as_they_are.

Differential: 6007 command lines (every string constant in the working tree's tests/*.py plus 220 handcrafted), each asked of the real PreToolUse(Bash) hook as bound member AGENT_A and as Spud, against a pristine HEAD copy and the working tree. 354 answers changed, 0 refused -> silent, 0 deny -> allow. By ticket: SPD-049 member 111 / spud 127; SPD-045 member 32 / spud 33; SPD-035 spud 33 (members unchanged); SPD-037 spud 2 and 10 deny -> deny where the reason now names the directory the shell really is in; objective 5, 4 member deny -> deny naming the write verb instead of PATH or hash. Scripts in the scratchpad: differential3.py, lines3.py, spd049_classify.py, spd049-classified.txt.

Verified: whole suite OK (873); tests/probes/hook_timing.py 30 rounds against main within 0.3 ms on every hook case; tests/test_package.py OK; no bytecode left; git status shows only the eight planned deliverables.

Proposals: 99 (P1, Law 7's table misses git stage = add, git init-db = init and the plumbing write verbs -- probed), 100 (P2, a glob or expansion that becomes one of the new file options is read only as spelled; the fix needs expansions.py and globbing.py, outside my globs), 101 (P3, bugreport and diagnose with no -o write into the cwd), 102 (P3, Spud's target holding a variable is still unchecked), 103 (P2, an arithmetic command (( n > 2 )) is read as a redirection -- a class already there for (( a > b )) and (( n >= 3 )), which SPD-045 widens; pinned as it now stands).

Open: nothing blocking. Module sizes: analyse.py 397 and walk.py 372 are still the two over the look-again line; I would not split either -- analyse.py grew by one dispatch line and its 262-line analyse_words is the one function the skill argues for keeping whole. syntax.py is 319 and git_verbs.py 301, both tables and small functions read by name.

## Outcome
Accepted. SPD-049, SPD-045, SPD-037 and SPD-035 are closed, plus wave 2's FINDING_LAST ordering; 31 new tests and four flipped cases; suite 873 OK; hook timing within 0.3 ms of main; the differential over 6007 lines as member and as Spud changed 354 answers with none refused-to-silent and none deny-to-allow, each attributable to one of the four tickets. Five proposals became tickets, and Spud raised the one he flagged: the arithmetic-versus-redirection reading is SPD-045's only user-visible cost and refuses ordinary lines like while (( n > 2 )), so it is P1, not P2.
